description: Source code for the TaxExemption80GCertificate class, handling validation, address setting, total calculation, and payment retrieval for tax exemption certificates in ERPNext.

classes.name: TaxExemption80GCertificate
classes.description: Represents a tax exemption certificate with validation, address, total calculation, and payment retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the certificate, including date, duplicates, and company details.

methods.name: validate_date
methods.description: Validates that the certificate date falls within the fiscal year if recipient is 'Member'.

methods.name: validate_duplicates
methods.description: Checks for duplicate certificates for the same donation.

methods.name: validate_company_details
methods.description: Ensures required company details like 80G number and PAN are set.

methods.name: set_company_address
methods.description: Sets the company's address and display address.

methods.name: calculate_total
methods.description: Calculates total payment amount if recipient is not 'Donor'.

methods.name: set_title
methods.description: Sets the title based on whether recipient is 'Member' or 'Donor'.

methods.name: get_payments
methods.description: Retrieves and appends membership payment details for the member.
